brief.prompt: make me a video about a lighthouse keeper who finds a message in a bottle
brief.style: painterly 35mm film still, muted teal and amber, soft dusk light, shallow depth of field

tier_reason: 24 GB rules out max (needs 40); standard est fits 60 GPU-min

bible.logline: A lonely keeper finds a bottle that was written to her.

cast.descriptor: Mara, a 30-year-old lighthouse keeper, wiry build, weathered olive skin, short salt-and-pepper hair, deep-set grey eyes, navy wool peacoat over a cream cable-knit sweater, brass compass on a cord

shots.narration: Every night for eleven years, Mara kept the light.

still.prompt: Painterly 35mm film still. Extreme wide shot at dusk: a white lighthouse stands on a black basalt cliff at frame right, beam unlit, rough teal sea filling the lower half, amber sky band on the horizon, a single lit window. Muted teal and amber palette, soft haze, shallow depth of field.

video.prompt: Static camera. Waves roll in slow and heavy below the cliff; the lantern room flickers on and the beam begins one slow sweep from right to left.

still.prompt: Painterly 35mm film still. Medium shot inside a brass lamp room at dusk: Mara, a 30-year-old lighthouse keeper, wiry build, weathered olive skin, short salt-and-pepper hair, deep-set grey eyes, navy wool peacoat over a cream cable-knit sweater, brass compass on a cord, standing at frame left polishing the great lens with a cloth, warm amber lamp glow on her face, cold teal window light behind her. Shallow depth of field.

video.prompt: Slow push-in. She polishes in small circles, pauses, and glances out of the window toward the sea.

still.prompt: Painterly 35mm film still. Wide shot on a pebble beach at low tide: Mara, a 30-year-old lighthouse keeper, wiry build, weathered olive skin, short salt-and-pepper hair, deep-set grey eyes, navy wool peacoat over a cream cable-knit sweater, brass compass on a cord, crouching at frame center over a green glass bottle half-buried in wet pebbles, lighthouse small in the background at frame right, amber dusk light. Shallow depth of field.

video.prompt: Gentle handheld drift. She brushes pebbles away and lifts the bottle; foam slides around her boots.

shots.narration: Inside was a letter. It had her name on it.

still.prompt: Painterly 35mm film still. Close-up of weathered hands unrolling a yellowed paper letter, handwritten ink line reading "Mara" visible at frame center, green glass bottle in soft focus at frame left, amber light grazing the paper.

video.prompt: Static camera. The paper uncurls in the wind; a fingertip traces the name.

still.prompt: Painterly 35mm film still. Close-up portrait of Mara, a 30-year-old lighthouse keeper, wiry build, weathered olive skin, short salt-and-pepper hair, deep-set grey eyes, navy wool peacoat over a cream cable-knit sweater, brass compass on a cord, eyes wet, reading, wind lifting her hair, lighthouse beam passing behind her head, teal and amber rim light. Shallow depth of field.

video.prompt: Slow push-in on her face. She exhales, half-smiles; the beam sweeps behind her.

shots.narration: Someone out there had been watching the light, too.

still.prompt: Painterly 35mm film still. Extreme wide shot: the lighthouse beam fully lit sweeping across a dark sea, a tiny distant boat light answering on the horizon at frame left, first stars, muted teal and amber.

video.prompt: Slow crane up and back. The beam sweeps; far out, the small boat light blinks twice.
